title: Lunar Lander (PhET)

inputs.name: Left Arrow key (keyCode 37)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.angleLeft(): plays the left side-thruster animation/sound, and (only while crashState == "inFlight") rotates the lander -3 degrees (3*pi/180 radians).

inputs.name: Right Arrow key (keyCode 39)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.angleRight(): plays the right side-thruster animation/sound, and (only while crashState == "inFlight") rotates the lander +3 degrees (3*pi/180 radians).

inputs.name: Up Arrow key (keyCode 38)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.increaseThrust(), raising thrust by 5% of maxThrust via setThrust().

inputs.name: Down Arrow key (keyCode 40)
inputs.description: Calls myLander.decreaseThrust(), lowering thrust by 5% of maxThrust via setThrust().

inputs.name: Spacebar (keyCode 32)
inputs.description: Toggles thrust: if current thrust is 0, sets it to maxThrust; otherwise sets it to 0.

inputs.name: P key (keyCode 80)
inputs.description: Toggles pause: if paused, unpauses (restartMotion(), plays alarm sound, hides pausedSign_mc); if running, pauses (stopMotion(), stopAllSounds(), shows pausedSign_mc).

inputs.name: R key (keyCode 82)
inputs.description: Calls _root.reset(), resetting the lander, score, view and landing marks.

inputs.name: Start button (introPlaque_mc.startButton_mc)
inputs.description: A ControlButton wired with action = null; press/release nudges the clip visually but triggers no assigned action in the given code.

inputs.name: Reset button (view2_mc.resetButton_mc)
inputs.description: A ControlButton wired with action = _root.reset; releasing it resets the simulation.

inputs.name: Help button (view2_mc.helpButton_mc)
inputs.description: On rollover/rollout shows a paused- or running-state icon frame depending on motionPaused; on press calls _root.help(), which toggles the help plaque and pause state.

state.name: pos
state.description: Lander position in meters; x is horizontal range, y is altitude (y<=0 means on/below the ground).

state.name: velocity
state.description: Lander velocity in meters/second, integrated each physics tick.

state.name: acceleration
state.description: Lander acceleration in meters/second^2, derived from thrust, orientation and gravity each tick.

state.name: angle
state.description: Lander tilt angle; changed by 3*pi/180 per angleLeft/angleRight call while inFlight; forced to 0 on any landing/crash resolution.

state.name: remainingFuel
state.description: Fuel remaining; depleted by useFuel() in proportion to thrust and elapsed time, divided by specificI=3050.

state.name: currentMass
state.description: massEmpty (6839) + remainingFuel, recomputed every physics tick.

state.name: crashState
state.description: Flight/landing status, set in evolveOneTimeStep() when pos.y crosses 0 from above.

state.name: landingSpeed
state.description: Speed magnitude (sqrt(vx^2+vy^2)) captured at the instant of touchdown; undefined while inFlight.

state.name: boulderCrash
state.description: Set true once the lander's base hits the boulders movie clip; prevents repeated side-crash handling.

state.name: motionPaused
state.description: Whether the P key or Help button has paused the physics interval.

state.name: mag / Nmag
state.description: Camera zoom factor and zoom-step counter used to rescale/pan view_mc as the lander nears the top/bottom of the screen.

state.name: nbrLandings
state.description: Count of landingMark clips attached to the ground, used to name/remove them on reset.

state.name: score / nbrSoftLandings / nbrHardLandings
state.description: Maintained by the external ScoreKeeper object (myScoreKeeper); its internal logic is not part of the given source files.

rules.description: Gravitational acceleration is a fixed constant g = 1.6, subtracted from vertical acceleration every physics tick.

Each physics tick (evolveOneTimeStep, run on a 40ms setInterval while in motion): computes dt from real elapsed time since last tick; while pos.y >= 0, vertical acceleration = thrust*cosTheta/currentMass - Constants.g and horizontal acceleration = thrust*sinTheta/currentMass; position and velocity are integrated from these using dt (Euler-style with a 0.5*dt^2 position term).

When pos.y drops below 0 while crashState was "inFlight", landing is resolved: landingSpeed = sqrt(vx^2+vy^2) is recorded, velocity/acceleration are zeroed, thrust is set to 0, angle/cosTheta/sinTheta are reset to level, and crashState is set to "softLanded" if landingSpeed < softLandingSpeed (2) and angle < 0.2, "hardLanded" if landingSpeed < hardLandingSpeed (6) and angle < 0.2, otherwise "crashLanded" (which also zeroes remaining fuel and plays an explosion sound).
Lander physical/fuel constants: massEmpty = 6839, initialFuel = 816.5, maxThrust = 45000, specificI (specific impulse) = 3050.

useFuel(dt), called every physics tick, reduces remainingFuel by thrust*dt/specificI; plays a low-fuel alarm once when remainingFuel/initialFuel < 0.1, and a separate alarm once when remainingFuel reaches exactly 0; recomputes currentMass = massEmpty + remainingFuel; clamps remainingFuel to 0 and thrust to 0 if fuel goes negative.

setThrust(thrust) only takes effect while remainingFuel > 0; thrust is clamped to [0, maxThrust]; reaching exactly maxThrust plays a full-thrust sound, any value strictly between 0 and maxThrust adjusts thrust-sound volume proportionally, and exactly 0 stops the thrust sound.
increaseThrust()/decreaseThrust() adjust thrust by ±5% of maxThrust (0.05*maxThrust) through setThrust().

angleLeft()/angleRight() always trigger the corresponding side-thruster animation clip and side-thrust sound unless crashState == "crashLanded"; the angle itself (and cosTheta/sinTheta) only actually changes by 3*pi/180 radians while crashState == "inFlight".

Keyboard dispatch: arrow keys/space/P/R are handled in a single onKeyDown switch that calls angleLeft/angleRight/increaseThrust/decreaseThrust, toggles thrust via setThrust(0 or maxThrust), toggles pause (stopMotion/restartMotion, stopAllSounds, alarm sound, pausedSign_mc visibility), or calls _root.reset().

detectBoulderCrash() tests two points at the lander's lower-left and lower-right (45% of landerBody width, 32% of landerBody height from center) against view_mc.boulders_mc with hitTest(); on a right-side hit (and not already boulderCrash) it zeroes thrust, sets velocity.x = -2, sets angle = -10/radToDeg, sets boulderCrash = true, switches landerBody_mc to its "rightDamage" frame, and zeroes remaining fuel; a left-side hit does the mirror image (velocity.x = 2, angle = 10/radToDeg, "leftDamage" frame).
Whenever myLander.boulderCrash is true, boulderCrashReport_mc is made visible (checked every frame in detectLanding/updateGame).

detectLanding(), run every frame: when crashState first leaves "inFlight" after being flagged landed, it calls myScoreKeeper.updateLandings(), updates the score readout text, attaches a numbered landingMark clip at the touchdown point, shows landingSpeedReport_mc with message1_txt = landingSpeed_str + (landing speed rounded to 1 decimal) + " m/s", and sets message2_txt to softLanding_str, hardLanding_str, crashDamaged_str, or crashKilled_str depending on crashState (the damaged/killed split is decided by comparing the rounded landing speed string to myLander.damageLandingSpeed), also setting landerBody_mc to "bottomDamage" or "destroyed" frames for those two crash cases; message3_txt/message4_txt are set from myScoreKeeper.nbrSoftLandings/nbrHardLandings.
When crashState returns to "inFlight" after having been landed, the boulder-crash and landing-speed report panels are hidden again.

updateGame() rescales the camera (mag) by x3 or /3 when the lander's screen point crosses 75% (zoom in, limited to Nmag < 1) or 5% (zoom out, limited to Nmag > -2) of stage height, via resetView(), and pans view_mc horizontally to keep the lander's screen x within 10%-90% of stage width.
On-screen lander rotation = myLander.angle * radToDeg; the thrust-flame clip's vertical scale = 200 * (thrust/maxThrust) percent and its alpha = 20 + 60 * (thrust/maxThrust).

updateGauges(), run every frame, sets the artificial horizon's rotation to angle*radToDeg, writes rounded height (pos.y) and thrust and range (pos.x) values into their text fields, and calls the fuelGauge_mc/vY_mc/vX_mc clips' own update() methods.

updateArrows(), only run when arrowsShown is true, scales/rotates a velocity arrow and an acceleration arrow (both hidden by default per the init-time _visible=false on velAccArrows_mc) based on the magnitude and direction of myLander.velocity and myLander.acceleration.

reset() (bound to the R key and to the Reset ControlButton) re-initializes the lander at position (initX=45, initY=50) with zero velocity via reInitialize(), re-initializes the score keeper, hides the crash/landing report panels, removes every attached landingMark clip and resets nbrLandings to 0, resets view_mc's scale to 100% and position to (0,0), resets landerBody_mc to its "good" frame, and resets the zoom state (mag=1, Nmag=0).

Lander.reInitialize(xInit, yInit) sets pos/velocity to the given position and zero, then calls initialize(), which resets angle, cosTheta/sinTheta, fuel (to initialFuel), thrust (to 0), currentMass, boulderCrash and the fuel-alarm-sounded flags to their start-of-sim values.

Pausing (P key or via help()) calls myLander.stopMotion() (clearInterval on the physics loop) and stopAllSounds(), and shows pausedSign_mc; unpausing calls myLander.restartMotion() (re-establishes the 40ms setInterval) and plays an alarm sound, hiding pausedSign_mc.
help() additionally toggles helpPlaque_mc's visibility together with the pause state described above (shown while paused by help, hidden on unpause).

The Help button clip's own onRollOver/onRollOut frames differ depending on motionPaused (frame 5 or "unPause" while paused, frame 2 or 1 while running), and onPress both flips that frame and calls _root.help().

ControlButton wires its clip's onRollOver to bold the label_txt and onRollOut to unbold it; onPress nudges the clip +2,+2 pixels; onRelease (and onReleaseOutside, aliased to the same handler) moves it back -2,-2 pixels and then invokes the constructor-supplied buttonAction callback.
The Start button is constructed with action = null (so releasing it currently calls no function) and the Reset button is constructed with action = _root.reset.

Startup sequence: the timeline's onEnterFrame polls simStrings.isLoaded() every frame (tracing "Loading XML."); once the external string file is loaded it clears onEnterFrame and calls init() exactly once.

init() builds the entire UI (GUIPanel, moreGUI, view_mc/view2_mc containers, boulders, landerHolder, landingLine, landingSpots, resetButton, scoreReadout, helpButton, pausedSign, introPlaque, boulderCrashReport, landingSpeedReport, helpPlaque), positions every piece using Util.setXYPosition at fixed fractions of stageW/stageH, hides the crash/landing/paused/help-plaque/velAccArrows elements by default, sets both thrust-flame clips to their "blank" frame, registers the keyboard listener, and creates the Lander, ScoreKeeper and Internationalizer objects.
World-to-screen conversion uses pixPerMeter = 7: the lander holder's screen x = pos.x * pixPerMeter and screen y = 0.9*stageH - pos.y * pixPerMeter.

outputs.name: GUIPanel_mc readouts
outputs.description: Artificial horizon rotation, height (rounded pos.y), thrust (rounded thrust value), range (rounded pos.x), plus fuel/vY/vX gauge widgets updated every frame.

outputs.name: landingSpeedReport_mc
outputs.description: Shown on landing/crash with the landing speed message and a status message (soft/hard/damaged/killed), plus running soft- and hard-landing counts.

outputs.name: boulderCrashReport_mc
outputs.description: Shown whenever the lander has registered a boulder collision.

outputs.name: pausedSign_mc
outputs.description: Shown while motion is paused (via P key or help()).

outputs.name: scoreReadout_mc score_txt
outputs.description: Text readout of myScoreKeeper.score, updated on init, on landing, and on reset.

outputs.name: Lander visuals
outputs.description: lander_mc rotation reflecting angle, thrust_mc scale/alpha reflecting thrust level, landerBody_mc frame reflecting damage state (good/bottomDamage/destroyed/rightDamage/leftDamage), left/right thruster animation clips.

outputs.name: landingMark clips
outputs.description: One mark attached to the ground view per completed landing, removed again on reset.

outputs.name: Camera/view transform
outputs.description: view_mc scale (mag) and position, rescaled/panned to keep the lander visible on screen.

notes: SoundMaker, ScoreKeeper, Internationalizer, Util, and the edu.colorado.phet.flashcommon.* classes (FlashCommon, CommonButtons, SimStrings) are referenced and called but their source was not provided, so their internal behavior (e.g. what ScoreKeeper.updateLandings()/initialize() actually compute, what Util.setXYPosition/Util.STAGEW/STAGEH do) could not be verified beyond the call sites shown.

ControlButton's constructor accepts a buttonLabel parameter (ControlButton.as:8) but never assigns or uses it anywhere in the class; it's unclear from the given code whether the clip's label_txt is expected to already be set by the asset/timeline, since the code only checks it's non-null (ControlButton.as:11-14) without ever writing to it.

Units for the numeric constants (g=1.6, softLandingSpeed=2, hardLandingSpeed=6, damageLandingSpeed=12, angle threshold 0.2) are not stated in the given source; they are inferred to be m/s^2, m/s, m/s and radians respectively from context and surrounding arithmetic (e.g. radToDeg usage), not confirmed by a citation.
crashLander() in DoAction.as (lines 315-318) is defined but has no visible call site anywhere in the four given files; it may be dead code or invoked from a clip/timeline not provided.

Line 293 of DoAction.as (detectBoulderCrash) contains a bare statement `s;` with no effect, referencing an apparently undeclared variable `s`; likely a decompiler artifact rather than functional behavior, since nothing else in the given files declares or uses `s`.

Actual values of stageW/stageH (from Util.STAGEW/STAGEH) are not visible in the given source, so only the fractional placement/scaling rules could be verified, not the resulting absolute pixel positions.

trace()-only debug strings ("Error: Control Button Clip does not have label_txt. Clip is " in ControlButton.as:13, "CRASH!" in Lander.as:162, "Lander Crashed!" in DoAction.as:317, "Loading XML." in DoAction.as:415) are developer console output, not shown to the end user in a running SWF, so they are intentionally excluded from literalStrings.

`_level0.backupSimName = "lunar-lander"` (DoAction.as:377) and the SimStrings bundle name `"lunar-lander-strings"` (DoAction.as:411) are internal identifiers (save-state/localization keys), not user-facing copy, so they are excluded from literalStrings.

MovieClip frame-label strings used with gotoAndStop/gotoAndPlay ("blank", "begin", "good", "bottomDamage", "destroyed", "rightDamage", "leftDamage", "unPause") select pre-existing animation frames rather than being literal copy shown as text, so they are excluded from literalStrings.
